_about: Startup JS + CSS budget of index.html in bytes, checked by tools/check-size.js (definition in its header). 2.0 was 1,569,203 bytes; 2.1 adds 11,962 (the import progress through every step, the report's collapse and toggle, the version beside the name, their strings and icons): 1,581,165, rounded up to the next 5 kB. 2.3 adds the Settings choice for cells merged over rows and the Word / HTML importer's filled-out table grid: 1,584,772, within the same budget. The PDF importer loads on demand; the builders (PowerPoint included) still load at startup — loading them on first use (TODO.md, High) lowers it.
